from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    case_cause_or_charge: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action or criminal charge stated in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The category of the case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[CaseRecord]
